title.narrative: #FreeTurkeyJournalists II - Promoting freedom of expression and independent journalism

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to contribute to an improved media environment that supports independent, quality journalism, and access to quality news to the broader public. The action aims to expose the numerous and complex ways in which free expression and media freedom rights are routinely violated and to strengthen the collective voice of those journalists who expose human rights violations and seek to promote independent journalism in Turkey.
